open_work: Twenty-six immutable records supply seven assemblies. Five original shelf heights, forty accepted parcel owners and all existing shirt/apparatus positions remain. New posts and bearers support the retained decks from the actual .01m floor.

The ticket rail receives rack-mounted metal standoffs, wire and individual ties to the thirteen original blank ticket positions. Thin paper replaces thick source boxes; no invented dates or lettering.
The window stand gains floor feet and framed joinery while retaining its empty source-owned top and plywood back. No new inventory is inferred.

The counter retains its source top datum, with an 8mm inset at the north wainscot, with framed lower panels and a visibly hinged closed flap at the south end. The original access gap around that end remains. This visual fitting introduces no opening interaction.

The bench reaches the original floor; its seat datum remains. Ledger and pencil lower to the existing worktop and maintain distinct source owners. No service, custody, purchase or utility owner changes.
Native fit and rendered QA precede production review; broad finishes, route continuity, functional mechanisms, runtime contracts and human acceptance remain separate.
